g.text: Customer signs in and reviews cart
Choose paid order or pickup reservation
Validate vendor, quantities, availability, stock, and prices
Create one Order AND one Transaction per vendor
Calculate server-side subtotal and fulfillment fee
Store booking reference and available tracking details
Show paid order and delivery status
Keep order paid; mark delivery booking for retry/attention
Show paid confirmation and delivery issue
Show paid order confirmation and pickup status
Reject invalid cart; create no order and no transaction
Customer arrives at the stall and tenders cash
Order.status is unchanged - cash is a payment event
Show error: cash less than total
Every status guard reads Order.status - the single lifecycle
holds courier progress. No fact is stored twice.
